mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the Federal Funds rate above 5.25% for three consecutive months reduces near-term discount rates, lowering the present value of expected equity cash flows and thereby depressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses and remains above 5.25% for ≥3 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not statistically lower than the 30-day rolling mean during the high-rate period (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the 12-month change in CPIAUCSL exceeds +2% in a month, it signals accelerating inflation expectations that compress real equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: During such CPIAUCSL spikes, SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative relative to the prior month's mean (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in monthly PAYEMS accompanied by a simultaneous decline in UNRATE indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings expectations and drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by ≥10% while UNRATE decreases by ≥0.2 percentage points in the same month
failure_condition: During such labor-market events, SPX 5-day forward returns are not statistically positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When monthly GDPC1 exceeds 2% above its 12-month moving average for two consecutive quarters, it reflects robust consumer demand that supports corporate earnings growth and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > +2% above 12-month MA for ≥2 consecutive quarters
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns during such periods are not significantly higher than the 12-month pre-event mean (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO by ≥5% for three months signals softening business capacity, raising uncertainty about future earnings and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases by ≥5% for ≥3 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns during such contraction are not statistically lower than the prior 60-day mean (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in HOUST and RSAFS above their respective 12-month moving averages by at least 5% each month for two months indicate robust industrial and retail demand, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > +5% MA and RSAFS > +5% MA for ≥2 consecutive months
regime_hint: dual industrial and retail demand acceleration
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns during such dual acceleration are not statistically positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 3.0% for three consecutive months in a context of rising HOUST, it signals a shift toward labor market accommodation that lowers policy risk and supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 3.0% for ≥3 consecutive months and HOUST increases
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns during such labor market shifts are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged period of declining FEDFUNDS below 1.00% for four consecutive months is interpreted as monetary easing that lowers real rates, supporting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns during easing are not statistically higher than the prior 60-day mean (t-test p > 0.05).
